norm: Physical area-weighted radial quadrature and unnormalized angular sample sum. Modal energy uses exact discrete Fourier multiplicity on the uniform shifted score grid.
probe_scope: At theta=0 only the real parts of the positive modal coefficients contribute. Different modes can cancel and the three probe radii do not sample the whole near-field grid.
limitation: The error distribution localizes the observed startup difference. It does not prove an instability mechanism or a causal attribution.
